pipeline.license_origin: Internal (post-2019 Janssen sale of Bermekimab; Natrunix is a separately developed True Human anti-IL-1a antibody)

indications.indication: Advanced pancreatic cancer (in combination with ONIVYDE + 5-FU/LV)
indications.highest_phase: Phase 1/2 (completed; FDA discussions ongoing for path forward)
indications.trial_name: Natrunix + ONIVYDE + 5-FU/LV in advanced pancreatic cancer
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING per ctgov; last subject completed 120 weeks dosing in April 2025; preliminary data announced June 2024 (reduced hospitalization, fewer SAEs, longer PFS); regulatory path being discussed with FDA
key_milestones: Ongoing FDA discussions on regulatory path

indications.trial_name: Natrunix in Combination With Methotrexate for RA Treatment
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; Natrunix 400 mg + MTX vs placebo + MTX
indications.trial_status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING (planned start July 15, 2026); follows prior 233-subject study (NCT05363891) whose data company deemed uninterpretable due to enrollment irregularities
key_milestones: Prior Phase 2 (NCT05363891) data deemed uninterpretable Dec 2024

indications.trial_name: Natrunix in HLA-B27 Positive Subjects With Axial Spondyloarthritis
indications.trial_design: Randomized; Natrunix vs vilamakitug vs placebo

pipeline.target: IL-1a (anti-IL-1a candidate; second parallel anti-IL-1a antibody)

indications.indication: Brain reperfusion injury after stroke reperfusion procedures
indications.trial_name: Hutrukin to Analyze Safety and PK in Healthy Volunteers
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 COMPLETED Q1 2024; planned Phase 2 stroke study placed on hold pending FDA clarification of cancer/arthritis regulatory paths

indications.trial_name: Safety & Efficacy of True Human Antibody, 514G3, in S. aureus Bacteremia
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED 2016; remains a clinical-stage asset per 10-K but no active or planned next study disclosed
